notes.raw:
\*Data except enthalpy of formation at 298 K estimated. Phase changes: 1128 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of Nd; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.724$ kcal/mol. 1289 K, melting point of Nd; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.707$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{0} = 8.884 + 0.028 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.615 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ $H^{0} - H_{298}^{0} = 8.884 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.014 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 0.615 \times 10^{2} T^{-1} - 2.856$ Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-1128 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 17.165 + 0.744 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 3.111 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 99.750 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 17.165 - 0.744 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 3.111 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 49.875 \text{T}^{-1} - 15.195 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1128-1289 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 20.279 - 5.945 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.146 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 27.350 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 20.279 + 5.945 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 0.146 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 13.675 \text{T}^{-1} - 61.601 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1289-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 18.394 - 5.808 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.146 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 27.350 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 18.394 + 5.808 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 0.146 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 13.675 \text{T}^{-1} - 59.150 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K from Schumm (104). Other data are those estimated by Mills (80).
